verdict.rationale: Inngest supports isolated testing: a testing library mocks function state, steps, and inputs (docs-14), and community users praise a local dev server / local mode for debugging (comm-7, comm-9). The REST API also references multiple environments (docs-7), but no evidence explicitly documents a sandbox or staging environment separated from production data. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing sandbox/branch/test environments isolated from production, documentation of the local dev server itself, and evidence of how AI agents (via MCP/CLI) can be scoped to non-production environments.
